description: This file contains the implementation of the 'BestSeller' controller class within the OpenCart admin extension module namespace. It manages CRUD operations, report generation, and synchronization of bestseller product data in the admin panel.

classes.name: BestSeller
classes.description: Controller class managing Bestseller modules, including CRUD, report generation, and data synchronization.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, sets page title, prepares breadcrumbs, handles both creation and editing of the bestseller module, and renders the main view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to save (add/edit) bestseller module settings, including validation and permission checks, and returns JSON responses.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Implements the installation logic for the bestseller module, checking permissions and calling the model installation method.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles uninstallation, verifying permissions, and calling the model's uninstall method.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates a report of the bestseller products, including pagination, and renders the report view.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches paginated report data, including product info and total sales, formatted for display.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the bestseller data with the latest product sales, updating or deleting entries accordingly.
